title: Navigation system usability and accuracy
summary: Feedback about the G60 navigation system centers on usability, comparisons with earlier vehicles, and some reports of inaccurate guidance or system instability, while many sampled mentions are too brief or ambiguously labeled to determine sentiment confidently.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the navigation or broader in-car technology, but the examples are limited and not detailed about specific features.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe the navigation as worse than prior BMW systems, cumbersome to use, inaccurate about road conditions, or prone to freezing and resets.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews often mention the navigation system without enough context to confirm sentiment, and some apparently favorable wording is still labeled undetermined in the supplied data.

limitations: More than half of the reviews in this topic are labeled undetermined, which limits confidence in a clearer sentiment read.
Several sampled fragments are very short or administrative-style descriptions, so they do not provide enough context about the customer experience.

Some supplied examples contain wording that appears positive or unclear while being labeled undetermined or negative, so this summary follows the assigned sentiment labels rather than reclassifying them.
The positive evidence is sparse and lacks concrete feature-level detail.
